facts.fact: The document is the text of Niger's Loi n° 2004-011 of 30 March 2004 on the organisation of statistical activity, which creates the Institut National de la Statistique and the national statistical system; it states it was adopted by the National Assembly and promulgated by the President.
facts.system: Loi n° 2004-011 du 30 mars 2004 portant sur l'organisation de l'activité statistique et créant l'Institut National de la Statistique

systems.system: Loi n° 2004-011 du 30 mars 2004 portant sur l'organisation de l'activité statistique

facts.fact: At the SYNPIS congress of 8 October 2025 the union's outgoing secretary general said an INS committee had drafted an ordonnance setting the fundamental principles of statistical activity and instituting a national statistical system, and sent it to the Secretariat General of the Government for adoption.
facts.system: Projet d'ordonnance sur les principes fondamentaux des activités statistiques et instituant un Système Statistique National

facts.fact: The Council of Ministers of 23 January 2026 adopted a draft ordonnance on the fundamental principles of statistical activities, instituting a National Statistical System and a national fund for statistical activity; the document does not say it was promulgated.
facts.system: Projet d'ordonnance relative aux principes fondamentaux des activités statistiques et instituant un Système Statistique National

note: Draft decrees on the Conseil National de la Statistique and the INS were also adopted as drafts, so no reach fact.
SPI score only; the in-force law is already held.
